keywords.name: ANTI-EVADE
keywords.text: The target's Evade Roll against this weapon takes a -X modifier.

keywords.name: BULKY
keywords.text: This weapon cannot shoot while its Unit is Engaged.

keywords.name: BURST FIRE
keywords.text: A model whose target is within Y inches gets +X Rate of Attack with this weapon.

keywords.name: CONCENTRATED FIRE
keywords.text: One attack with this weapon removes at most X models; leftover damage is lost.

keywords.name: CRITICAL HIT
keywords.text: After Surge, shift up to X dice from the Armour Pool straight into the Damage Pool.

keywords.name: INDIRECT FIRE
keywords.text: May ignore Line of Sight; if no target model is in sight, the target may Evade.

keywords.name: INSTANT
keywords.text: Enemies cannot use Reactions against an attack made with this weapon.

keywords.name: LOCKED IN
keywords.text: +X Rate of Attack when the target Unit is Stationary.

keywords.name: LONG RANGE
keywords.text: Maximum range becomes X inches; dice from models beyond the printed range take -1 to hit.

keywords.name: PIERCE
keywords.text: Against a Unit with the named Combat Tag this weapon's Damage becomes X.

keywords.name: PINPOINT
keywords.text: May shoot at an Enemy Unit that is already Engaged.

keywords.name: PRECISION
keywords.text: After hitting, up to X missed dice count as hits.

keywords.name: SIDEARM
keywords.text: Used on top of the model's normal weapon, as a separate batch.

keywords.name: SPECIALIST
keywords.text: Only one named model of the Unit carries this upgrade.

keywords.name: SPILLOVER
keywords.text: Other Units under a template are hit as separate bare batches.

keywords.name: BUFF
keywords.text: Raise a characteristic by X until the End of the Round; only the highest BUFF per characteristic counts.

keywords.name: DEBUFF
keywords.text: Lower a characteristic by X until the End of the Round; only the highest DEBUFF per characteristic counts.

keywords.name: DISPLACEMENT
keywords.text: The model or token can be pushed aside so others can pass or stand there.

keywords.name: HEAL
keywords.text: Remove up to X damage from the Unit; never brings back removed models.

keywords.name: HITS
keywords.text: The Unit takes X automatic hits of Damage Y, starting at the Armour Roll.

keywords.name: IMPACT
keywords.text: Roll X dice per eligible model, each Y+ is a hit on the charged Unit.

keywords.name: MORPH
keywords.text: Replace X models of a Unit with the named Unit.

keywords.name: NON-LETHAL DAMAGE
keywords.text: Deal X damage that can never remove the Unit's last model.

keywords.name: PLACE
keywords.text: Lift the Unit and set it down within X inches, ignoring the path between.

keywords.name: RESPAWN
keywords.text: Return up to X removed models, never raising the Unit's Supply bracket.

keywords.name: SUMMON
keywords.text: Put the named Summoned Unit onto the table.

keywords.name: DODGE
keywords.text: When targeted, Surge and CRITICAL HIT move X fewer dice past the Armour Roll.

keywords.name: TOUGH
keywords.text: On an Armour Roll, up to X failed dice count as passed.

keywords.name: BURROWED
keywords.text: Underground: limited actions, hard to target, no contesting.

keywords.name: HIDDEN
keywords.text: Not Visible to Enemy models more than 4 inches away.

keywords.name: SIEGE MODE
keywords.text: Deployed artillery stance; unlocks siege weapon profiles.

keywords.name: STATIONARY
keywords.text: The Unit has not repositioned this Round.

keywords.name: SHIELDED
keywords.text: The Unit still has Shield points left.

keywords.name: ON CREEP
keywords.text: The Unit stands on Creep, which powers some Zerg abilities.

keywords.name: REPEATABLE
keywords.text: The ability may be used more than once in a Round.

keywords.name: STAY IN PLAY
keywords.text: The card's effect lasts across Rounds instead of ending at the End of the Round.

keywords.name: STRUCTURE
keywords.text: Never activates or acts, counts as 0 Supply, never holds markers, and ignores most abilities.

keywords.name: INDOMITABLE
keywords.text: Can shoot and be shot by Unengaged Units while Engaged; the defender may Evade those attacks.

keywords.name: LARGE
keywords.text: Needs wide gaps, and crushes small impassable terrain pieces it drives over.
